resource: Typed-identity footprint of one creature death's loot plan (death key, loot table ref and every accepted entry's item ref and purpose key)
allocation_impact: Charged incrementally as each entry is accepted (header once, then one charge per accepted entry); rejected before the running total, or a single addition, would exceed the ceiling. Never truncated.
boundary_tests: max=30,720 B: the running footprint accepts an addition that lands exactly on the ceiling
max+1=30,721 B: an addition that would land one byte over the ceiling is rejected
16 maximum-content-key-width entries (512 B keys/revisions) plus header fit exactly at 30,720 B
consumers: apps/game-server/src/combat/loot_plan.rs (plan_creature_loot / charge_plan_bytes: header once, then per accepted entry)
notes: D77, decision §4.1/§4.1.1: 16 * 1,792 B + 2,048 B = 30,720 B, the exact worst case of `durability/item_mint.rs`'s own TypedDefinitionRef/content-key encoding at DUR03-RL-07 field maxima. Registered by OTV2-20260928-combat-d2a-loot-plan.
